item.title: Amazon Quick Generative AI Integration
item.description:
Amazon Quick Spaces Chat Agents

Estimated duration: 15 mins

Amazon Quick Generative AI Integration

Overview

Amazon Quick is an AI-powered workspace. Spaces organize relevant resources, and chat agents can use approved context for natural-language analysis.

Learning Objectives

  • Understand Spaces.
  • Configure a FinOps chat agent.
  • Ground the agent in dashboards/context.
  • Define safety and evidence expectations.

Why This Matters for FinOps

Generative AI is most useful after the platform already has trusted cost evidence. It should synthesize and investigate, not invent financial calculations.

item.title: Natural Language FinOps Queries
item.description:
Amazon Quick Chat Agents FinOps

Estimated duration: 15 mins

Natural Language FinOps Queries

Overview

This lab treats natural-language analysis as an interface over trusted evidence, not a replacement for Athena or CUDOS.

Learning Objectives

  • Ask visibility questions.
  • Ask period-comparison questions.
  • Ask attribution questions.
  • Evaluate unsupported claims.

Why This Matters for FinOps

Accessibility improves when users can ask plain-language questions, but governance still requires traceability back to the data.
